schema.convention: |A7| = |A|: the construction is a 1:1 map over valid requests.  The shipped file instantiates A as a deterministic TRAIN-row sample.
schema.description: VALID factor requests carrying one REDUNDANT term (a factor repeated at the value it already has).  The structural control for the C set's 'duplicate_factor' records: same term count, same term ordering, same repeated-factor pattern, and still satisfiable.  Built from valid requests alone -- no invalid example is used.

record.id: stable string id, unique within the file
record.request: list of {factor, factor_index, value} terms; every factor named once plus ONE repeat of a single factor at its own value
record.row: dataset row this request denotes (it is satisfiable, and this is it)
